audit_summary.summary: Most specialist claims are faithful factual descriptions or appropriately bounded abstentions. Two macro inferences require verification because they assign issuer/ETF-level impulse despite acknowledging absent transmission evidence. The integrated views are therefore conditional and predominantly mixed; price triggers are descriptive technical discriminators, not calibrated forecasts.
